title: Marketing for Consultants Study 2024 (& How To Get More Clients) | Consulting Success®

facts.fact: In the page's survey of consultants, making phone calls was the marketing method that gets consultants the most clients, at 16%.
facts.quote: The most effective form of marketing for consultants is making phone calls (16%).

facts.fact: In the page's survey, direct mail and print advertising was the second most effective marketing method for getting clients, at 15%.
facts.quote: The second most are direct mail/print advertising (15%), and the third is networking & events (14%).

facts.fact: In the page's 2019 study, 38% of consultants chose referrals as their highest income-earning marketing method.
facts.quote: In 2019, referrals make consultants the most money — with 38% of consultants choosing referrals as their highest income-earning marketing method.

facts.fact: The page's author states that its survey was sent to over 50,000 consultants on the Consulting Success list.
facts.quote: a survey that we sent to over 50,000 consultants on our list (updated for 2024)

facts.fact: According to the page's 2023 study summary, 40% of consultants invest $5K or less in their marketing each year.
facts.quote: 40% of consultants invest $5K or less in their marketing each year.

facts.fact: According to the page, nearly 70% of consultants have a proposal win rate of less than 60%.
facts.quote: Nearly 70% of consultants have a proposal win rate of less than 60%.

facts.fact: According to the page, for over half of consultants, 60% of their business comes via referral.
facts.quote: For over half of consultants, 60% of their business comes via referral.

facts.fact: According to the page, over 70% of consultants generate 8 calls or less per month.
facts.quote: Over 70% of consultants are generating 8 calls or less per month

facts.fact: According to the page, only 25% of consultants market their business daily.
facts.quote: However, only 25% of consultants market their business daily.

facts.fact: According to the page, 39% of consultants market their business weekly and 24% market their business monthly.
facts.quote: 39% market their business weekly, and 24% market their business monthly.

facts.fact: According to the page, 9% of consultants only market their business when they need a client, and 3% do not market their business at all.
facts.quote: 9% of consultants only market their business when they need a client, and 3% don’t market their business at all.

facts.fact: In the page's 2023 survey, making phone calls was the top-rated marketing method consultants spend their time on, at 14%.
facts.quote: The top-rated answer was making phone calls at 14%.

facts.fact: In the page's 2023 survey, networking and events was the most-voted area consultants planned to improve in 2023, at 14%.
facts.quote: The most voted answer was Networking and events (14%).
